theorem LeanProofs.eq_one_of_mul_left.{u_1} : ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (e a : G), e * a = a → e = 1 :=
fun {G} [Group G] e a h =>
  have h2 := Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a * a⁻¹ = a * a⁻¹) h)) (Eq.refl (a * a⁻¹));
  Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 1) (mul_one e))
    (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => e * _a = _a) (mul_inv_cancel a))
      (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a = a * a⁻¹) (mul_assoc e a a⁻¹)) h2))
